temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is a dedicated doctor and friend, but he may not have fully realized how unsustainable Gary's work habits have become.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan's concern is confirmed, and Gary's refusal shows the overwork is serious and Gary is not currently willing or able to step away.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is severely overworked and his hospital obligations are preventing him from taking needed rest.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Worry, concern, and some disappointment at Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene and encourage Gary to rest, possibly by finding another way to help him take a break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan sees that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly caused by hospital demands and stress, and he hoped the retreat would help Gary relax.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now suspects that Gary's overwork is tied to deeper personal issues, not just professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with complicated personal problems and has been hiding them to avoid burdening others; he needs nonjudgmental support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern, empathy, and unease as his suspicions are confirmed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary and encourage him to open up so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was struggling with deeper issues behind his overwork, but he did not yet know the specific causes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now understands the reasons behind Gary's behavior and sees that Gary is open to making changes.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overwhelmed by new department pressures and personal challenges, but with help he can find a better work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, and delegate responsibilities so he can make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports progress: he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie, though challenges remain.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is trying to change and can improve with ongoing support, though progress may still be uneven.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan sees that Gary's efforts are producing real improvement and that his support is helping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier work-life balance and is not as overwhelmed as before.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, encouraging Gary, and offering support when needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and credits Ethan's support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and still benefits from encouragement, but he is not yet certain Gary can manage fully on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Ethan now sees that Gary can manage independently and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a sustainable work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
